original.collision: Grove artwork did not define a collider; that remains unchanged.

implementation: GroveView caches real Sprite artwork by site ID, retains unit art scale and integer positions, and uses existing nearest-neighbor texture settings.
Stump sorts in actors at ground contact minus CHARACTER_FOOT_OFFSET_PX. Matching mushrooms and a restrained existing shadow texture are beneath actors.
Twelve mushroom sprites replace the old stones/mushrooms; old primitive trunk/branches and tinted ground ellipse removed.
Renderer extras and visual manifest register four cropped PNGs; debug groveViews exposes bound texture sizes/scale/depth; missing art contributes to placeholder diagnostics.
Cleanup removes obsolete sprites on site removal, world replacement and renderer teardown while retaining shared textures.
Ghost effects/HUD, simulation rules, site IDs, generation output, passable collision and save schemas unchanged.

screenshots.comparison: comparison.png: before left, after right; identical 320x160 game captures enlarged 2x with nearest sampling for inspection only. Runtime art is not resampled.
screenshots.otherEvidence: after/: daylight/night, behind/front, 1280/1920/800 viewport captures, reload and seeds 1/42/123/1337 in Chromium and Firefox.

visualReview: Inspected full and close scenes in actual WebGL, including generated woodland surroundings and night/ghost manifestations. Stump texture and warm woodland palette fit nearby logs/vegetation; root and mushroom boundaries are clean. Actor overlap agrees with feet depth. No new floating sprites, opaque grass patches or stretching observed in these captures.
